info.description: The foot of every page: its link columns, its social links, the mark beside the copyright and the small print.

logo.description: The mark beside the copyright. The original uses a smaller, simpler mark here than in the header, so this is its own image rather than the header logo scaled down.

columns.description: The link columns. The column number decides which of the four they stack into, so several groups can share one.

socialLinks.description: The icon links at the foot. Pick artwork from the social set of the Icon Library.

note.description: The small print under everything else.
